solutionSql:
SELECT id, route_id,
       SUM(weight_kg) OVER (PARTITION BY route_id ORDER BY booked_at, id
                            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::integer AS running_kg
FROM shipments
WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY route_id, booked_at, id;

ambiguities.phrase: counting shipments in booking order (booked_at, then id)
ambiguities.readingChosen: Window ordered by booked_at, id with an explicit ROWS frame from the partition start to the current row, so each shipment adds exactly its own weight even on booked_at ties.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Default RANGE frame ordered by booked_at only, which would give tied shipments the same combined total; rejected because the ticket names id as the tie-breaker.

ambiguities.readingChosen: SUM result (bigint) cast to integer to match the declared column type.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Leave SUM as bigint; values are identical.

notes: Rows with NULL weight_kg are filtered in WHERE before the window, so they are neither output nor counted. Partition by route_id keeps a separate total per route; the first shipment on each route equals its own weight.
